title: My Story
gist_ar: حكاية إزاي الكاتب اتحسن في الإنجليزي.
text: When I was ten, I hated English, because it was difficult and I was shy. My teacher was kind, so she gave me a small book and said, 'Read one page every night.' First, I understood only a few words, but I continued. After six months, I could read a whole page easily. Then I started to watch films in English, and I remembered new words because I heard them again and again. I also talked to my cousin in English before school. Finally, last year I explained a lesson to my class in English. My life changed, because I decided not to stop.

questions.q: Why did the writer hate English at first?
questions.q_ar: الكاتب كره الإنجليزي في الأول ليه؟
options: It was difficult and he was shy
